svg.title: The Gray-Scott (F, k) plane
svg.desc: Regions of the feed and kill plane by the fate of the non-trivial uniform state, the saddle-node and Hopf curves, and the six isotop anchors.
svg.text: Gray-Scott (F, k) plane: where the uniform state lives, and isotop's anchors
no non-trivial state: k above the saddle-node
tr J > 0: oscillates, no Turing band
stable without diffusion, unstable with it
Du = 0.2097, Dv = 0.105 (lattice units, dt = 1), growth rates from the 5-point lattice dispersion relation
